history.summary: Large 1,604 sqft 99LH 3BR at Punggol's Prive for $1.8M / $1,122 psf — the low PSF is partly a function of an oversized unit on a long-lease (2014) project. Pench-of-water Punggol location with only LRT (not MRT) access caps the buyer pool and appreciation versus PDD-adjacent stock.
history.rating_rationale: PSF of $1,122 is genuinely cheap for D19 and the $1.8M quantum sits in a liquid band, but the 1,604 sqft size inflates quantum-per-buyer and the unit relies on Cove LRT (240m) rather than the East-West/Cross Island heavy rail that drives PDD uplift. 99LH from 2014 means ~87 years left — fine — but no URA data was matched here so the appreciation case is unverified. High arena score (744) is largely a value/PSF artifact.

catalysts: Punggol Digital District and SIT campus maturing nearby

history.summary: Privatised Punggol EC (D19): a large 1,604 sqft 3BR asking $1,122 psf vs verified recent project transactions averaging ~$1,545-1,582 psf — a genuine ~25-27% discount, the largest verified bargain in this batch; the 'very_low_psf' flag reflects real value, not a mis-scrape.
history.rating_rationale: Web-verified: Prive's last-12-month sales averaged ~$1,545 psf and ~$1,583 psf over 6mo, versus the $1,122 psf asking — a ~27% gap. Even applying a meaningful large-unit/big-quantum discount (1,604 sqft is near the top of the project's 775-1,772 sqft range), the implied fair value of a unit this size is roughly $2.3-2.4M, so $1.8M leaves real upside. The algo's age_adj_premium of -33.9% directionally matches my verified read. Now fully privatised (since 2023), Cove LRT ~260m, NEL connectivity, and Punggol's digital-district/regional-centre buildout give a genuine OCR catalyst — the region the v3.4 backtest ranks highest for forward returns. Confidence is medium not high because appreciation_txns=0 and psf_cohort_txns is null (regional_baseline fallback), so I rely on web comps, and the buyer must verify the listing/condition is current (large gaps occasionally signal a stale or distressed listing).
red_flags: appreciation_txns=0 and psf_cohort=null — algo used regional fallback, so verify listing is live and unit condition (a ~27% gap can hint at a stale or problem unit)

catalysts: Punggol Digital District / regional centre buildout driving employment and demand
Fully privatised since 2023 — full resale pool (incl. foreigners/companies) and long-run en-bloc optionality
